title: Research Methods in Bioengineering; Modeling in Bioengineering using COMSOL
description:
Prerequisites: BIOE371 or BIOE246.

This course introduces students to bioengineering modeling and simulation using COMSOL Multiphysics, with applications spanning tissue mechanics, fluid flow, transport phenomena, and bioelectric fields. Emphasis is placed on building, solving, and analyzing multiphysics models that address bioengineering problems.
